skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Short instruction files that Orqen adds to a role's brief. Imported skills are linted and need your approval before any role uses them.
skills.sheetHelp: Read the skill, check its lint result, then approve or retire a version.
skills.updateAvailable: A newer built-in version is available as a draft.

import.title: Import a skill
import.help: Choose a SKILL.md file or paste its text. It is stored as a draft; nothing runs until you approve it.
import.contentHint: Front matter (name, description, roles, when) followed by the instructions.

lint.title: Lint
lint.blockedHelp: A blocking finding (for example a secret-like value) cannot be approved. Remove it and import again.

codes.tool_or_credential: Asks for a tool or credential
codes.policy_change: Pushes a policy change (approve, publish, merge, skip review)

approve.title: Approve
approve.ackHelp: Acknowledge each flag to confirm you read it.

bindings.title: Role bindings
bindings.orgHelp: The skills each role gets in every project that has no set of its own.
bindings.projectHelp: When this project has bindings, they replace the organization set.
